# 0b Sign-in + UI shell: contract

**Read first:** [sign-in](../processes/platform/sign-in.md), [platform module](../modules/platform.md), [ADR 0006](../adr/0006-one-public-host-for-admin-and-public-urls.md), [ADR 0014](../adr/0014-server-rendered-ui-templ-htmx.md), [ui/README.md](../ui/README.md), [ui/design/README.md](../ui/design/README.md), `tokens.css`, screens `RP-Sign-in`, `RP-Main`, `RP-Keys`, `RP-Vocabulary`, `RP-Settings`.

**Done when:** `proxier manage create-admin` creates the admin; signing in on `/login` shows the empty dashboard in the shell (header, sidebar, key line); `/`, `:`, `?`, `g d` and `g ,` work; EN/RU switch works; Settings → General saves; Settings → Security changes the password and lists and ends sessions; every edge case below has its test; the page passes the CSP with no console errors.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| i18n | **Own small catalog** (`internal/platform/i18n`), messages as Go maps per module, EN and RU side by side. `golang.org/x/text/language` only for `Accept-Language` matching. | Two languages, compiled in, no extraction tooling. go-i18n's files, IDs and plural machinery cost more than the Russian plural rule (one/few/many, ten lines). Keeping EN and RU in one literal makes a missing translation a test failure. |
| Placeholders | `{name}` in the text, values from `i18n.Args{"name": v}`; `{{` is a literal brace. | Readable in both languages; word order can differ. |
| Plurals | `Loc.N(key, n, args)`: the text holds forms separated by `\|` — EN 2 (one, other), RU 3 (one, few, many). `{n}` is the formatted count. | |
| Numbers | EN `1,284`; RU `1 284` (U+00A0). | ui/README "numbers use the language's formatting". |
| Password hash | argon2id (`golang.org/x/crypto/argon2`), RFC 9106 second recommendation: m = 64 MiB, t = 3, p = 4, 16-byte salt, 32-byte key, stored as a PHC string `$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=3,p=4$<salt>$<hash>`. At most 2 hashes at once (semaphore). Tests use m = 1 MiB, t = 1, p = 1 through `auth.Service.Params`. | The PHC string carries its parameters, so they can change later; the semaphore caps memory at 128 MiB under a flood. |
| Unknown user | Verified against a dummy hash made at start with the same parameters. Every failed sign-in answers no sooner than **1 s** after the request began (`auth.FailureFloor`). | "Same message and same timing." |
| Admin row | `admin.id` is always 1 (`CHECK (id = 1)`). | "Exactly one admin" enforced by the schema. |
| Session token | `vault.NewToken()` (256 bits) in the cookie; the row stores `vault.Lookup(token)`. Sessions have an integer `id` for the Security page. | Token never stored; rows addressable without exposing it. |
| Cookie | `__Host-proxier_session` when `PROXIER_BASE_URL` is https (`Secure`, `Path=/`, no `Domain`), `proxier_session` over http (dev). `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, no `Max-Age` beyond the absolute expiry (set `Expires` = absolute expiry). | `__Host-` makes the browser enforce "scoped to the admin host". |
| CSRF | Two layers. (1) Go's `http.CrossOriginProtection` (Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin) on every unsafe method, including `/login`. (2) A token tied to the session: `base64url(HMAC-lookup("csrf\x00" + session token))`, never stored, sent as form field `_csrf` or header `X-CSRF-Token`; htmx sends the header from `<body hx-headers='{"X-CSRF-Token":"…"}'>`. Compared with `hmac.Equal`. `/login` POST has only layer 1 (no session yet). | Stateless, dies with the session, and the standard-library check stops cross-site posts before the token is even read. |
| Lockout | Derived from `sign_in_attempts`, not stored. An IP is locked when its last N failures after its last success span ≤ the window; locked until the N-th failure + the duration. Attempts while locked are refused without checking or recording anything. Defaults N = 5, window 15 min, duration 15 min, in settings section `security`. | Survives restarts by construction; a success resets the count ("4 failures, then success"). |
| `new_ip` | No successful sign-in from that IP in the 30 days before this one. | sign-in.md. |
| Last seen | Updated when ≥ 1 min old, with `last_ip`. Idle expiry = `last_seen_at + 7 d`; absolute = `created_at + 30 d` (stored as `expires_at`). | |
| Expired session | The middleware redirects to `/login?next=<path>&ended=idle` (or `absolute`); the sign-in page shows "Signed out after 7 days idle. You'll go back to <page>." Expired rows stay until retention (0c). | RP-Sign-in's third state. |
| htmx and auth | An htmx request without a valid session gets `401` with `HX-Redirect: /login?next=<HX-Current-URL path>`, not a 302 (htmx would swap the login page into a fragment). `web.Redirect` does the same for every redirect from an htmx request. | |
| `next=` | Accepted only when it parses as a path starting with `/`, not `//` or `/\`, with no scheme or host, and is not `/login` or `/logout`; otherwise `/`. | sign-in.md edge case. |
| Language | Signed out: `Accept-Language` matched to en/ru; if neither matches, the admin's language; else `en`. Signed in: the admin's `language` column. New admin gets `general.language`. Switch: admin menu → `POST /me/language` → `admin.language_changed`. | ui/README; the 0b spec. |
| CSP | `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`. No inline scripts, no `style=""` attributes, no `hx-on`. Data for scripts goes in `data-*` attributes or `<script type="application/json">`. | "A strict CSP." Templates use classes only; the screens' inline styles become classes in `app.css`. |
| Other headers | `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: same-origin`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()`, and `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000` when the base URL is https. Admin pages: `Cache-Control: no-store`. | |
| htmx config | htmx **2.0.x** vendored (exact version and sha256 in `static/VENDOR.md`), `<meta name="htmx-config" content='{"includeIndicatorStyles":false,"allowEval":false,"allowScriptTags":false,"selfRequestsOnly":true,"historyCacheSize":0,"refreshOnHistoryMiss":true}'>`. | No inline styles or eval under the CSP; `historyCacheSize: 0` keeps pages (which may show secrets) out of localStorage. |
| Static files | Embedded under `internal/platform/ui/static`, served at `/static/<hash>/<path>`, where `<hash>` is the first 12 hex chars of a SHA-256 over every embedded file's path and content, computed once at start. Other hashes → 404. `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. | One hash keeps URLs simple; a deploy changes it. |
| Fonts | IBM Plex Mono woff2 400, 400 italic, 600, 700, from the IBM Plex release, with `OFL.txt`. The `@import` of Google Fonts is removed from the app's copy of `tokens.css`. | Self-hosted; CSP `font-src 'self'`. |
| Stylesheets | `static/css/tokens.css` (copy of the design's, minus the import), `fonts.css`, `app.css` (layout and components). From 0b on, the app's copy is the source of truth; `docs/ui/design/README.md` says so. | The design README: "Once the app's own stylesheet exists, it takes over." |
| Actions and search | `ui.Action` renders every button and link that does something, with `data-action` and its label. The `:` / `/` pop-up collects **actions from the page's DOM** (`[data-action]`, including hidden global actions in the layout) and **things from the server** (`GET /search?q=`, the "Go to" group: nav pages, settings sections, and module `Searcher` hits). | A button and its search entry are the same element, so they always share their words, and nothing is listed that can't be done on this page. |
| Keymap | One file, `static/js/proxier.js`, plain JS. Keys are declared by markup: `data-goto="d"` on nav links, `data-row` + `data-href` + `data-hint` on list rows, `data-key="r"` on page or row actions. The `?` sheet is server-rendered from `ui.Keymap` into a `<template>`. Letters never fire inside a field. | Progressive enhancement: every key maps to an element already on the page. |
| Settings pages | Generic form for any settings section (`ui.SettingsForm`), rendered from the fields; labels from `settings.field.<key>` and `settings.field.<key>.help`, section titles from `settings.section.<name>`. Sections with more than fields (Security; later Telegram, SSH, Backups) register a `ui.SettingsPage` with their own handler. | Modules get a settings page for free. |
| Package split | `auth` is the domain (no Echo); `web` is HTTP plumbing (depends on `auth`, `i18n`); `ui` is templ components and assets (depends on `i18n` and the `settings` types only, takes view structs); `pages` holds the platform's handlers. | No cycles; `ui` stays reusable by modules. |

Settings section `security` (new, platform):

| Key | Kind | Default | Bounds |
|---|---|---|---|
| `security.lockout_failures` | int | `5` | 3–20 |
| `security.lockout_window` | duration | `15m0s` | 1m–24h |
| `security.lockout_duration` | duration | `15m0s` | 1m–24h |

Session lifetimes are constants (`auth.IdleTimeout`, `auth.AbsoluteTimeout`): "every session lasts the same".

## Tables — `internal/platform/migrations/00002_auth.sql`

```sql
-- +goose Up

-- The one admin. Created only by `proxier manage create-admin`.
CREATE TABLE admin (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    username            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(username) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    password_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,   -- PHC string, argon2id
    language            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (language IN ('en', 'ru')),
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_changed_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Sessions. The cookie holds a token; the row holds vault.Lookup(token).
-- Idle expiry is last_seen_at + 7 d; expires_at is the absolute one.
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    token_hash   BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    admin_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admin (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_ip   TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_ip      TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_agent   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- truncated to 512 chars
    ended_at     TEXT,
    end_reason   TEXT CHECK (end_reason IN ('signed_out', 'signed_out_everywhere', 'password_changed', 'password_reset')),
    CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL) = (end_reason IS NULL))
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX sessions_open ON sessions (admin_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL;

-- Every sign-in attempt that was checked (not those refused by a lockout).
-- Drives the lockout and new_ip. Kept 30 days.
CREATE TABLE sign_in_attempts (
    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    ip      TEXT NOT NULL,
    time    TEXT NOT NULL,
    success INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (success IN (0, 1))
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX sign_in_attempts_ip ON sign_in_attempts (ip, time);
CREATE INDEX sign_in_attempts_time ON sign_in_attempts (time);

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE sign_in_attempts;
DROP TABLE sessions;
DROP TABLE admin;
```

Until 0c's retention job exists, `SignIn` deletes attempts older than 30 days in its own transaction.

## Go signatures

### `internal/platform/i18n`

```go
type Lang string

const (
	EN Lang = "en"
	RU Lang = "ru"
)

var Langs = []Lang{EN, RU}

// Message is one text in both languages. Plural texts hold their forms
// separated by "|": EN one|other, RU one|few|many.
type Message struct{ EN, RU string }

// Messages is a module's catalog: key → message.
type Messages map[string]Message

// Args fill {name} placeholders.
type Args map[string]any

type Catalog struct{ /* … */ }

func NewCatalog() *Catalog
// Add registers a module's messages. A key added twice, a message missing a
// language, or EN and RU with different placeholder sets is an error.
func (c *Catalog) Add(module string, m Messages) error
func (c *Catalog) Has(key string) bool

// Localizer renders for one language and display time zone.
type Localizer struct {
	Lang Lang
	TZ   *time.Location
	// …
}

func (c *Catalog) Localizer(l Lang, tz *time.Location) *Localizer
// T renders key. A missing key renders as the key itself and is logged once.
func (l *Localizer) T(key string, args ...Args) string
// N renders the plural form for n; {n} is the formatted count.
func (l *Localizer) N(key string, n int64, args ...Args) string
func (l *Localizer) Number(n int64) string
func (l *Localizer) Time(t time.Time) string     // "2026-10-07 16:52" in TZ
func (l *Localizer) Ago(t time.Time) string      // "4 min ago" / "4 мин назад"

func WithLocalizer(ctx context.Context, l *Localizer) context.Context
func From(ctx context.Context) *Localizer        // EN/UTC when none: never nil
func T(ctx context.Context, key string, args ...Args) string // shorthand for templates

// Match picks en or ru from an Accept-Language header; ok is false when
// neither is acceptable.
func Match(acceptLanguage string) (l Lang, ok bool)
```

### `internal/platform/auth`

```go
const (
	IdleTimeout      = 7 * 24 * time.Hour
	AbsoluteTimeout  = 30 * 24 * time.Hour
	LastSeenEvery    = time.Minute
	NewIPWindow      = 30 * 24 * time.Hour
	AttemptRetention = 30 * 24 * time.Hour
	MinPasswordLen   = 12   // characters (runes)
	MaxPasswordLen   = 1024 // bytes
	FailureFloor     = time.Second
)

var (
	ErrAdminExists      = errors.New("auth: an admin already exists")
	ErrNoAdmin          = errors.New("auth: no admin yet")
	ErrWrongCredentials = errors.New("auth: wrong username or password")
	ErrPasswordTooShort = errors.New("auth: password shorter than 12 characters")
	ErrPasswordTooLong  = errors.New("auth: password too long")
	ErrNoSession        = errors.New("auth: no session")
)

// LockedError: the IP is locked out; nothing was checked.
type LockedError struct{ Until time.Time }

// ExpiredError: the cookie names a session that ran out.
type ExpiredError struct{ Reason string } // "idle" | "absolute"

type Params struct{ Memory, Time uint32; Threads uint8 }

var DefaultParams = Params{Memory: 64 * 1024, Time: 3, Threads: 4}

func Hash(p Params, password string) (string, error)
// Verify reports whether password matches the PHC string.
func Verify(phc, password string) (bool, error)

type Admin struct {
	Username          string
	Language          i18n.Lang
	CreatedAt         db.Time
	PasswordChangedAt db.Time
}

type Session struct {
	ID                    int64
	CreatedAt, LastSeenAt db.Time
	ExpiresAt             db.Time // absolute
	CreatedIP, LastIP     string
	UserAgent             string
	// Set only on the session of the current request.
	Token string
	CSRF  string
}

type Service struct {
	Params Params                                     // DefaultParams
	Now    func() time.Time                           // time.Now
	Sleep  func(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) // pads failures to FailureFloor
	// …
}

func New(d *db.DB, v *vault.Vault, ev *events.Catalog, st *settings.Store) *Service

// Command line.
func (s *Service) AdminExists(ctx context.Context) (bool, error)
func (s *Service) CreateAdmin(ctx context.Context, username, password string) error           // admin.created; actor cli
func (s *Service) ResetPassword(ctx context.Context, password string) (ended int, err error) // auth.password_changed{via: cli}; ends every session

// Web.
type SignInResult struct {
	Session Session // with Token and CSRF
	NewIP   bool
}

// SignIn checks the lockout, then the credentials. It returns
// *LockedError, ErrWrongCredentials or ErrNoAdmin (shown as wrong
// credentials). Failures are padded to FailureFloor.
func (s *Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, username, password, ip, userAgent string) (SignInResult, error)
// Authenticate finds the open session for a cookie token and refreshes its
// last-seen time (at most once a minute). ErrNoSession or *ExpiredError.
func (s *Service) Authenticate(ctx context.Context, token, ip string) (Session, error)
func (s *Service) Admin(ctx context.Context) (Admin, error)
func (s *Service) Sessions(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) // open ones, newest first
func (s *Service) SignOut(ctx context.Context, sessionID int64, by string) error  // auth.signed_out{session, by}
func (s *Service) SignOutEverywhere(ctx context.Context) (int, error)              // auth.signed_out_everywhere{sessions}
// ChangePassword needs the current password; it ends every session except current.
func (s *Service) ChangePassword(ctx context.Context, current int64, old, new string) error // auth.password_changed{via: ui}
func (s *Service) SetLanguage(ctx context.Context, l i18n.Lang) error                        // admin.language_changed; no-op when equal
func (s *Service) CSRFToken(sessionToken string) string
func (s *Service) CheckCSRF(sessionToken, got string) bool

// BrowserName turns a user agent into "Chrome on macOS"; unknown parts read "Unknown browser".
func BrowserName(userAgent string) string
```

### `internal/platform/web`

```go
// Routes are the groups modules add routes to.
type Routes struct {
	Admin  *echo.Group // session required, CSRF on unsafe methods, admin headers
	Public *echo.Group // never reads or sets cookies; no-store, noindex (rate limits: Phase 2)
	Open   *echo.Group // no session needed, admin headers: /login, /static
}

// Request is what the middleware knows about the current request.
type Request struct {
	Admin   *auth.Admin   // nil when signed out
	Session *auth.Session // nil when signed out
	Loc     *i18n.Localizer
	HTMX    bool
}

func FromContext(ctx context.Context) *Request
func Render(c *echo.Context, status int, comp templ.Component) error
// Redirect answers 303, or 200 + HX-Redirect for an htmx request.
func Redirect(c *echo.Context, to string) error
// SafeNext returns raw when it is a local path that may follow sign-in, else "/".
func SafeNext(raw string) string

const (
	CSRFHeader = "X-CSRF-Token"
	CSRFField  = "_csrf"
)

func CookieName(secure bool) string // "__Host-proxier_session" | "proxier_session"

func SecureHeaders(httpsBase bool) echo.MiddlewareFunc
func PublicHeaders() echo.MiddlewareFunc
func Session(a *auth.Service, secure bool) echo.MiddlewareFunc // redirect or 401+HX-Redirect when signed out
func CrossOrigin(baseURL *url.URL) echo.MiddlewareFunc          // http.CrossOriginProtection
func CSRF(a *auth.Service) echo.MiddlewareFunc
func Static(fsys fs.FS, hash string) echo.HandlerFunc
func ErrorHandler(log *slog.Logger) echo.HTTPErrorHandler
```

Middleware order on admin routes: `SecureHeaders` → `CrossOrigin` → `Session` → `CSRF` → localizer → handler. An unknown path under the admin namespace without a session redirects to `/login` like a known one (nothing about the routes leaks).

	Items []NavItem

	Keys  []Key
}

func Asset(path string) string // "/static/<hash>/" + path
var StaticFS fs.FS
var StaticHash string

templ Layout(s Shell)     // children: the page
templ SignIn(v SignInView) // standalone page
templ SettingsLayout(s Shell, pages []SettingsPage, current string)
templ SettingsForm(sec settings.Section, vals []settings.Value, errs settings.FieldErrors, csrf string)
templ ActionButton(a Action)
templ Status(kind, word string) // kind: ok look blocked broken unknown off paused running gone
templ Band(kind string)         // love | gold | iris | pine
templ Area(title, note string)
templ Dialog(id, title string)  // <dialog>: title row with flush ×, body, footer
templ EmptyState(what, next string)
templ Time(t time.Time)         // relative text, absolute in title

### `internal/platform/module`

```go
type Deps struct {
	Cfg      *config.Config
	Log      *slog.Logger
	DB       *db.DB
	Vault    *vault.Vault
	Events   *events.Catalog
	Settings *settings.Store
	I18n     *i18n.Catalog
	Auth     *auth.Service
}

type Initializer interface{ Init(d Deps) error }
type MessagesDeclarer interface{ Messages() i18n.Messages }
type RouteDeclarer interface{ Routes(r web.Routes) }
type NavDeclarer interface{ Nav() []ui.NavItem }
type SettingsPageDeclarer interface{ SettingsPages() []ui.SettingsPage }
type Searcher interface {
	Search(ctx context.Context, q string, limit int) ([]ui.SearchHit, error)
}
```

### `cmd/proxier`

```go
// Prompter reads from the terminal; tests use a scripted one.
type Prompter interface {
	Line(prompt string) (string, error)
	Password(prompt string) (string, error) // no echo
}

func createAdmin(ctx context.Context, a *auth.Service, p Prompter, out io.Writer) error
func resetPassword(ctx context.Context, a *auth.Service, p Prompter, out io.Writer) error
```

`create-admin`: refuse at once when an admin exists ("An admin already exists; use reset-password."). Ask the username, then the password twice; a short or mismatched password says why and asks again (at most 3 rounds, then exit 1). Without a terminal on stdin: "Run it with docker exec -it". Usage text gains both commands.

## Routes

| Method, path | Group | What |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /login` | Open | Sign-in page; `?next=`, `?ended=idle\|absolute`. Signed in → redirect to `next`. |
| `POST /login` | Open | Sign in. Locked → page with "Too many attempts. Try again in N min." Wrong → "Wrong username or password." Success → new cookie, `303` to `SafeNext(next)`. |
| `POST /logout` | Admin | End this session, clear the cookie, `303 /login`. |
| `GET /` | Admin | Dashboard: title, empty state. |
| `GET /search?q=` | Admin | Fragment: "Go to" hits (nav, settings pages, `Searcher`s). |
| `POST /me/language` | Admin | `lang`, `next`; sets the admin's language. |
| `GET /settings` | Admin | `303 /settings/general` |
| `GET, POST /settings/general` | Admin | Generic form + base URL read-only row. FieldErrors inline, nothing saved. |
| `GET /settings/security` | Admin | Change password, sessions, lockout settings. |
| `POST /settings/security/password` | Admin | old, new, new again. |
| `POST /settings/security/lockout` | Admin | `security` section. |
| `POST /settings/security/sessions/:id/sign-out` | Admin | End one session (the current one → `/login`). |
| `POST /settings/security/sessions/sign-out-everywhere` | Admin | Strength-2 dialog first ("N sessions, including this one, will end"). |
| `GET /static/:hash/*` | Open | Embedded assets. |

## Keys in 0b

`/` search, `:` actions, `?` keys, `esc` close; `g d` dashboard, `g ,` settings (no letter in the design; `,` chosen); `j k` in the sessions list; `[ ]` previous/next settings section. Other `g` letters render in the `?` sheet only once their pages exist.

## Checklist

Sign-in edge cases ([sign-in.md](../processes/platform/sign-in.md#edge-cases-each-is-a-test)):

- [ ] `create-admin` with an 11-character password → refused, asked again — `cmd/proxier/admin_test.go` `TestCreateAdminAsksAgainForShortPassword`
- [ ] `create-admin` when an admin exists → refused, nothing changes — `cmd/proxier/admin_test.go` `TestCreateAdminRefusesWhenAdminExists`
- [ ] Wrong password → generic message, `auth.sign_in_failed`, no session — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestWrongPasswordRecordsFailureAndNoSession`
- [ ] Unknown username → same message and timing — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestUnknownUserLooksLikeWrongPassword` (same error; both verify one hash; both padded to `FailureFloor` through the fake `Sleep`)
- [ ] 4 failures, then success → signed in — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestFourFailuresThenSuccessSignsIn`
- [ ] 5th failure within 15 min → `auth.locked` once; 6th with the right password refused — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestFifthFailureLocksTheIP`
- [ ] Lockout expires after 15 min → correct password works — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestLockoutExpires`
- [ ] Failures from two IPs counted separately — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestFailuresAreCountedPerIP`
- [ ] `X-Real-IP` from an untrusted client is ignored — `pages/signin_test.go` `TestSignInIgnoresRealIPFromUntrustedPeer`
- [ ] Success from an IP seen 10 days ago → `new_ip: false`; 40 days ago → `true` — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestNewIPMeansNoSuccessInThirtyDays`
- [ ] `next=https://evil.example/` and `next=//evil.example` → dashboard — `web/web_test.go` `TestSafeNextAcceptsOnlyLocalPaths` (table: also `/\evil`, `javascript:`, `/login`, `/servers?x=1` kept)
- [ ] Session idle 7 d 1 min → `/login` — `auth/sessions_test.go` `TestIdleSessionExpires`
- [ ] Session used daily ends at day 30 — `auth/sessions_test.go` `TestSessionEndsAtThirtyDays`
- [ ] Password change on the laptop ends the phone's session at once, keeps the laptop's — `auth/admin_test.go` `TestPasswordChangeEndsOtherSessions`
- [ ] `reset-password` during a lockout → works, all sessions end, lockout still applies — `auth/admin_test.go` `TestResetPasswordEndsSessionsAndKeepsLockout`
- [ ] POST without a CSRF token → 403, nothing changes — `pages/settings_test.go` `TestPostWithoutCSRFTokenIsRefused`

The contract's own decisions:

- [ ] Cross-site POST (Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site) refused even with a token — `web/csrf_test.go` `TestCrossSitePostIsRefused`
- [ ] CSRF token from another session refused — `web/csrf_test.go` `TestCSRFTokenIsTiedToTheSession`
- [ ] htmx header token accepted — `web/csrf_test.go` `TestCSRFTokenInHTMXHeader`
- [ ] Cookie attributes over https and http — `web/session_test.go` `TestSessionCookieAttributes`
- [ ] Public group never sets or reads cookies — `web/session_test.go` `TestPublicRoutesIgnoreCookies`
- [ ] htmx request without a session → 401 + `HX-Redirect` — `web/session_test.go` `TestHTMXRequestWithoutSessionGetsHXRedirect`
- [ ] Expired cookie → `/login?ended=idle&next=…` — `web/session_test.go` `TestExpiredSessionRedirectsWithReason`
- [ ] Unknown admin path when signed out → `/login` — `web/session_test.go` `TestUnknownPathRedirectsToLoginWhenSignedOut`
- [ ] Last seen written at most once a minute — `auth/sessions_test.go` `TestLastSeenIsThrottled`
- [ ] Session token never stored — `auth/sessions_test.go` `TestSessionTokenIsStoredOnlyAsLookup`
- [ ] Attempts during a lockout aren't recorded and don't extend it — `auth/signin_test.go` `TestLockedAttemptsAreNotRecorded`
